newsitem.title: USA: Cabletron sees Q1 results below forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Cabletron sees Q1 results below forecasts.

text.p: Cabletron Systems Inc said on Monday that it expects to report first-quarter earnings per share of about $0.37, equaling or slightly exceeding its year-ago results but falling below analysts' expectations.
The First Call consensus estimate for Cabletron's first quarter of fiscal 1998 was $0.50 per share.

Cabletron said in a news release that it did not yet have details for the quarter to fully explain the results it expects to report on June 23. It expects revenues in the range of $360 million to $370 million and net income of about $57.1 million.
The company said demand appeared strong during the quarter for its newer, high-end switching products and its Spectrum software, but softer for some of its other products.
Production delays for some of the new products created a backlog that may have resulted in lost sales opportunities, Cabletron said.
The company said it was guarded about its seasonal summer quarter but more optimistic about subsequent quarters.
Cabletron shares closed up 1-3/4 to 45-3/4 on Monday, before it released its news release.
